title: The Drops of God
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When famed wine critic Yutaka Kanzaki dies, his will leaves his huge cellar to whichever of two sons can identify twelve wines he calls the 'Twelve Apostles' and a final wine, 'the Drops of God' (Kodansha blurb via MU; ANN). His estranged son Shizuku, who has never drunk wine, competes with adopted son Issei Tomine, a wine critic (ANN; AniList). Complete in 44 volumes; award-winning in France's wine world (MU); the earlier English release was dropped and Vertical began a new edition in 2025 (MU; ANN).
life_message: Wine, rightly appreciated, opens a path to memory, beauty and reconciliation with a father's legacy.

content.note: None noted; extreme wine hunts such as climbing the Matterhorn (ANN).
ANN reviewer lists 'the sex' and 'foodgasm' moments among the appeals; MU Subtle Romance (to verify).
Wine tasting is the entire subject (ANN; MU Alcohol, Sommelier; AniList Bar); adult drinkers, celebrated as connoisseurship.
Grief and estrangement from father (MU Dead Parent).
Encourages appreciation of wine; ANN says the aim is not personal investment in wine.
Real wines and vintages named and praised (ANN: 'here is a really delicious wine'; MU award from wine press).

folkways.japan: Respect for expert mastery and a father's will reflects Japanese norms of craft and family obligation; the wine culture itself is European.

delivery.evidence: ANN: 'here is a really delicious wine and here is the best way to appreciate it'; dense exposition front-loaded.
delivery.note: The series teaches wine appreciation directly through tasting descriptions rather than arguing a worldview.
